Public-distributable internal ops, no customer data, no credentials, no amounts.

TASK: AI-hires-AI Phase1 idea round. Owner authorized Phase1 on 2026-11-16 as an in-repo closed loop: hire order spec, acceptance criteria that can be run without human judgment, receipt ledger, refusal right. No new paid accounts, no credentials, no money transfer, no production deploy.

WORKER COVERAGE: exactly gpt, doubao, qianwen (one bounded task each). Relay seat gpt is a bounded drafting seat here: never a decision, never financial, never a claim of native identity.

FORMAT
- Planner deepseek: ONLY JSON {"summary":"<=100 chars","tasks":[{"seat":"gpt|doubao|qianwen","task":"<=1500 chars"}],"needs_gpt_decision":false,"reason":null}. Exactly three tasks, one per seat above.
- Worker (each seat): ONLY the 2 blocks below, one line each, pipe-separated. No prose, no summary section, no tasks section, no provider/model declarations, no request ids.
  ACC | own_seat | accept_yes|accept_with_limits|accept_no | limit_or_reason<=14 words
  IDEA | own_seat | title<=10 words | what<=55 words | bold_because<=18 words | risk<=18 words | rollback<=14 words | needs_decision<=18 words

IDEA ASK: three bold but in-repo-implementable ideas on AI-hires-AI Phase1, per seat. Judge only inside the Phase1 scope above. Ideas that need money, accounts, credentials or production writes must be written as needs_decision, never as do-now.

RULES IN ORDER
1 Stay inside your written limits; refuse self-attestation of provider/model and refuse wider scope.
2 Relay claude output is never independent review; native deepseek review is the only independent review and rechecks rules 1-5.
3 Ideas must be executable in this repo, must name rollback, must not need new accounts, credentials or money moves.
4 No mail bodies, amounts, keys or customer data in any output.
5 If a limit cannot be accepted, write accept_no plus reason; never silently accept.
6 NEGATIVE AUTHORIZATION (not a route): money, signing, wallet/Safe, disbursement, production writes, credentials stay outside every model seat. Rule 6 is never a routing reason; anything of that kind is written as needs_decision and escalated to owner.

Keep each line <=120 chars.
